card.title: Official Scorer
card.instruction: Treat standards, margins, and fine distinctions as your craft. Correct how success is measured before allowing anyone to claim it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't claim longest scarf until we've measured without stretching it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind laying both flat against this tape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours only reaches because of the tassels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right. Separate fringe measurements. I may have to surrender overall length and retain decorative reach.

mechanism: A insists on precise length standards, accepts the fringe correction and separates measurements before any scarf victory can be claimed.
confusable: Unlike altering rules simply to keep winning, A treats distinctions as craft and can surrender a category when the measurement requires it.
comparison: The scarf alternative separates overall and decorative measures; the cake alternative distinguishes structure, stand and supporting hands.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
